_comment: Language-detection cases across all three languages.
Every string is the length a real query is: short. `hard` marks the
cases where a general-purpose statistical detector is expected to fail
-- no diacritics, very short, mixed script, or not one of our three
HOW TO READ THE SCORE: these cases and the detector were written
together, so a high number here is a REGRESSION GUARD, not an unbiased
accuracy estimate. The honest finding is the gap on the hard cases
against the baseline, not the headline percentage.
`und` is a correct answer, not a failure. myGov, OTP and 123456 are not
decidable, and the app has a language picker to fall back on.
